items.html: And also for this reason this first Tevuna is called "the world to come" [Olam HaBa]. And the reason is that females are called "world," as is written in the Zohar, Vayechi, on the verse, "from world to world." And this Tevuna is called the World to Come, Alma DeAti, since she descends downward and is continually revealed. But the upper Bina remains above and does not descend; therefore Bina is called "the future to come" [Le'atid Lavo], for the upper Mochin of ZA, which clothe in the NHY of the upper Bina, are destined to come afterward, when his rank grows greater, and he will have upper Mochin greater than those of Bina, and not of Tevuna, and then it will be the future to come.
